  • スコア: 6.37/10 (42 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 純情ヤンキーとギャル子ちゃん エッチな色々教えてあげる♪
  • 英語名: Junjou Yankee to Gyaruko-chan - Ecchi na Iroiro Ochiete Ageru♪

あらすじ

Youhei, our protagonist, retired from the judo club because of an injury. Nothing out of the ordinary happens in his common student life.

And just like that, his childhood friends Azusa, a delinquent, and Rina, a gyaru, reappear after a long time.

-Yohe, sup. Why the dull face?

item.title: Siscon -Saiminjutsushi Onii-chan to Namaiki na Imouto-
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Atelier Sakura Mount Position
  • 発売日: 2016-06-10
  • スコア: 6.409999999999999/10 (32 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 妹コン ―催眠術師お兄ちゃんとナマイキな妹―
  • 英語名: Siscon -Saiminjutsushi Onii-chan to Namaiki na Imouto-

あらすじ

One day, while taking a nap, the protagonist, Kyouhei, had a strange dream.

In the dream, a self-proclaimed evil god said, “I’ll give you some kind of magic so you can conquer the world.”

Kyouhei gave a half-hearted reply that it was just a dream.

When they finished speaking, he was shocked and his consciousness faded, and when he opened his eyes, his younger sister, Ririka, was standing next to him.
